info.title: Ashicore Agent Production Planning API
info.description: Read-only raw production data for external AI assistants.

get.description: Returns raw production data: sales shipments, open MOs, product counts with lots, and product BOMs.

parameters.name: includePlanningFacts
parameters.description: Include item-level planning facts. Defaults to false for ChatGPT.

parameters.name: includeLots
parameters.description: Include product lot counts with received dates. Defaults to true.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, or expired agent API token.

403.description: The token does not have production-planning read scope.

agentBearerAuth.description: Use an Ashicore agent API token generated from the ERP. In ChatGPT Actions, configure authentication as API Key or Bearer token so requests send Authorization: Bearer <token>.

openSalesOrders.description: Open sales orders with planned shipment buckets, unplanned demand, and allocation state.

openManufacturingOrders.description: Open manufacturing orders that represent existing production supply.

productCounts.description: Current sellable product counts, lot counts with received dates, open sales demand, and open MO supply by product.

productBoms.description: Product-to-product BOMs for products in sales demand or open MOs, including minimum lot age requirements.
